title: 3DS Challenge object
description: Represents a challenge object for 3DS authentication

challenge_method_type.description: The type of challenge method issued to the cardholder

start_time.description: ISO-8601 time at which the challenge has started

expiry_time.description: ISO-8601 time at which the challenge expires

app_requestor_url.description: Fully qualified app URL of the merchant app. This should be used to redirect the cardholder back to the merchant app after completing an app-based challenge. This URL will only be populated if the 3DS Requestor App is provided to the 3DS SDK.
